mapper.select: SELECT * FROM forum_tags ORDER BY post_count DESC
SELECT * FROM forum_tags WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name})
SELECT * FROM forum_tags WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) AND category = #{category}

SELECT t.*, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count FROM forum_tags t INNER JOIN forum_post_tags fpt ON fpt.tag_id = t.id INNER JOIN forum_posts p ON p.id = fpt.post_id WHERE p.author_username = #{username} GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.name
SELECT * FROM forum_tags WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY post_count DESC, updated_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forum_post_tags fpt INNER JOIN forum_posts p ON p.id = fpt.post_id WHERE fpt.tag_id = #{id} AND p.author_username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM forum_post_tags fpt INNER JOIN forum_posts p ON p.id = fpt.post_id WHERE fpt.tag_id = #{id} AND p.author_username <> #{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_tags (name, post_count, category, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{postCount}, #{category}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_tags SET name=#{name}, post_count=#{postCount}, category=#{category}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE forum_tags SET post_count = post_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE forum_tags SET post_count = GREATEST(0, post_count - 1) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, fpt.post_id AS post_id FROM forum_tags t INNER JOIN forum_post_tags fpt ON t.id = fpt.tag_id WHERE fpt.post_id IN #{pid}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM forum_post_tags WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
DELETE fpt FROM forum_post_tags fpt INNER JOIN forum_posts p ON p.id = fpt.post_id WHERE fpt.tag_id = #{tagId} AND p.author_username = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_tags SET post_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_post_tags WHERE tag_id = #{id}) WHERE id = #{id}
